focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: Room to Move: Open and Closed Sets on the Real Line
utility_title: csv-statistics: Reproducible Column Summaries and Bootstrap Intervals
utility_use_case: A researcher has a CSV export of repeated instrument readings and wants a compact, reproducible summary for a lab report. Running the command with an explicit seed produces descriptive statistics and a percentile bootstrap mean interval in JSON, while also exposing how many selected cells were missing or unusable. The researcher can retain the command and output alongside the dataset, then investigate data quality or sampling design separately rather than treating the interval as a causal or significance result.
